rules.directions: Every edge is directed. Two edges are emitted for bidirectional roads; oneway=yes, oneway=-1 and roundabouts are respected.
rules.access: Any access/vehicle/motor_vehicle/motorcar=no is excluded. Private/permit ways remain restricted=true for an explicit authorized-service-access option.
rules.barriers: Blocked car barriers and nodes with a no access tag exclude incident segments. Gates are retained as gate=true; private gate access also makes a segment restricted.
rules.track: Track roads remain track=true for an optional allowTrack setting.
rules.geometry: Original OSM nodes and full way geometry are retained without simplification. length is WGS84 great-circle distance in metres.
rules.turns: The local router applies the retained node-via only/no turn restrictions using incoming directed-edge search states, including partial first and last edges.

limitations: The matched field region is covered by retained successful OSM map downloads. Full ways may extend outside this region without establishing complete surrounding coverage.
Pad labels are associated through the separate gps-points registry, based on source-schematic topology and visible mapped footprints. They are map-based access points, not surveyed well coordinates.
This is a static road snapshot. The two retained node-via turn restrictions are applied by the local router; conditional access, closures and real-time conditions are not modeled.
Connected components and coverage gaps can prevent a route even when a road exists in the real world.
